% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
% \version -- read straight out of app/version.py at build time.
%
% The manual must not be able to claim a version the application does not have,
% so nothing here is hand-maintained and there is no generated file to
% regenerate: TeX opens version.py itself, finds the APP_VERSION line and takes
% the text between its quotes.
%
% Needs a LaTeX kernel from 2020 or later (expl3 is part of the format by then)
% and a TeX allowed to read outside its own directory -- TeX Live's default
% openin_any=a is. If the read fails for any reason the build still finishes,
% with the version shown as "unknown" and a line in the log saying so; a
% missing version is worth noticing, not worth stopping for.
%
% Both candidate paths are tried so the manual builds from its own directory
% (the normal case, and what the Makefile does) or from the repository root.
% ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

\ExplSyntaxOn

\tl_new:N \g_bigagent_version_tl
\tl_gset:Nn \g_bigagent_version_tl { unknown }
\ior_new:N \g_bigagent_version_ior

\cs_new_protected:Npn \bigagent_read_version:n #1
  {
    \ior_open:Nn \g_bigagent_version_ior {#1}
    \ior_str_map_inline:Nn \g_bigagent_version_ior
      {
        \str_if_in:nnT {##1} { APP_VERSION }
          {
            % APP_VERSION = "0.51.3"  ->  split on the quote, keep the middle.
            \seq_set_split:Nnn \l_tmpa_seq { " } {##1}
            \int_compare:nNnT { \seq_count:N \l_tmpa_seq } > { 2 }
              {
                \tl_gset:Nx \g_bigagent_version_tl
                  { \seq_item:Nn \l_tmpa_seq { 2 } }
              }
          }
      }
    \ior_close:N \g_bigagent_version_ior
  }

\clist_map_inline:nn { ../../app/version.py , app/version.py }
  {
    \str_if_eq:VnT \g_bigagent_version_tl { unknown }
      {
        \file_if_exist:nT {#1}
          { \bigagent_read_version:n {#1} }
      }
  }

\str_if_eq:VnT \g_bigagent_version_tl { unknown }
  {
    \iow_term:n
      {
        ****~Big_Agent~manual:~could~not~read~APP_VERSION~from~app/version.py;~
        the~title~page~will~say~"unknown".~****
      }
  }

\cs_set:Npn \version { \tl_use:N \g_bigagent_version_tl }

\ExplSyntaxOff
